risks.risk: Model mismatch (seller says “ZZR”, but photos don’t clearly show the ZZR badge/model). Wrong model can change value a lot.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model badge/side fairing text OR the bike’s registration/VIN plate showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Kawasaki sport bike with unknown exact model.

risks.risk: Not actually working (electrical faults, clutch/gear issues, brake problems) despite “working fine” claim.
risks.proof: Short video of cold start + rev + gear shifting (1–5/6) + brake test (front and rear) with no warning lights.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst case: treat as needs inspection/possible minor faults).

risks.risk: Hidden damage or poor repair (frame alignment, fork damage, crash history) not visible in these limited photos.
risks.proof: Photos of both fork legs, both sides of the front wheel/fender, frame/engine mounts, and a straight-on shot of the bike from front and rear.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end of comparable range for similar listings.

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion or non-original parts (exhaust, brake pads/rotor, cables) not fully checkable from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of exhaust joints, brake rotor surface, brake pads thickness, chain/sprocket condition, and any aftermarket markings.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact model name “ZZR” (badge/side panel) or registration/VIN plate showing model.
Video: cold start, dashboard warning lights check, then gear shifting test and front/rear brake test.
Close-ups: brake rotor surface + brake pads thickness, chain/sprocket wear, exhaust condition (joints/heat discoloration), and both fork legs.
Receipt/warranty card or registration document showing purchase date (to support “bought new 6 months ago”).
response.reason: The photos confirm a Kawasaki sport motorcycle, but the exact “ZZR” model and the “working fine / brakes & gears perfect / original parts” claims are not provable from the provided images. Without decisive proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
